news.text: THE DOUBLE 9 LAUNCHES #JUVE#Woltemade-#Kolo: comeback in Vigo (2-1)#Conceição furious after the substitution: "No fight". #Spalletti: "He'd better be angry with himself".[Front Page Gazzetta dello Sport]

VENEMOUS #JUVEEuropa League: Lucio's masterstroke, a 2-1 comeback in Vigo.Super second half and #CeltaVigo overturned: goals from #Woltemade and #Kolo. #Spalletti is in first place. #Conceição's fury: he protests the substitution, punches the bench and walks away.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

WITH TWO OF THEM, IT'S A COMPLETELY DIFFERENT STORY#CeltaVigo-#Juve 1-2#Woltemade and #KoloMuani deliver the victory and 1st place.#Juve suffers, goes down, makes a lot of mistakes, but then the German exploits an assist from... #MarcosAlonso and returns to scoring in the cup. From #Nico and the Frenchman, who came on for a frustrated #Conceição (who reacted poorly) and #Alajbegović, the turning point for a great finale, capped by a goal at the 92nd minute. The German: "Yes, we work well together". #Spalletti: "Chico? I hope he is angry with himself. Otherwise, we will need to talk about it".[Front Page TuttoSport]

🎙Randal #KoloMuani to @SkySport:GOAL"We gave a lot and on a personal level I'm happy with this goal."#WOLTEMADE"I'm happy for him too, he always works very had and that's why I'm happy for him.We both scored and I am happy."MOMENTUM"It's very important, we completed a great comeback with a lot of energy.We are happy."#LAZIO"We are professionals, we always work hard.Many matches awaits us, but we are ready."[@PuebloJ]

🎙Francisco #Conceição to @SkySport:SUFFERING IN THE FIRST HALF"Yes, the first half went poorly.But, first of all, I want to say that I did not argue with anyone.When I came off, I gave a small punch to the bench where I sit, but I did not argue with anyone from the coaching staff.What they said is not true."DID YOU NOT HAVE A DISCUSSION WITH A MEMBER OF THE STAFF?"No, we didn't have a dialogue.I didn't speak to him and he didn't say anything to me.We didn't have any dialogue.I went inside, changed my shirt and then came back out.I was inside for three or four minutes: I went to the bathroom, changed the shirt and then came out.I want to clarify this because truth needs to come out, not these

🎙Luciano #Spalletti to @SkySport: #KOLOMUANI'S MOVEMENT"Kolo drifted wide like that, he interpreted the role too much as a winger, when he needed to be in that half-space, because that flank was supposed to be left open for #Cambiaso.But then we failed to manage the ball securely at certain moments of the match, leading to continuos shifts in the play. We were always late to close them down, they constantly found the free man in the middle, they forced us into long defensive adjustments that cost us a lot of running.Toward the end, #Woltemade was a bit tired; on the other hand, #Kolo, from that position, frequently found himself in 1v1 situations where he could make an impact, and since #Kol

🎙Nick #Woltemade to @SkySport:GOAL"I think tonight I played my best match for #Juventus, I did good things, but it's clear that I can do better.Goals give you confidence, I want to keep pushing and improving."PLAYING WITH #KOLOMUANI"I like playing with him, he's an excellent forward.When there are two forwards on the pitch, the defense can't just concentrate on one and it makes it difficult for our opponents.#Kolo did well, I'm happy."FUTURE"I am not the coach, I trust him.I believe that the two of us can do well together, but also separately."[@PuebloJ]
